title: Complete Interior Wall & Ceiling Painting
subtitle: Flawless multi-coat interior painting with plaster priming and drop-cloth protection
author: Bouul Painting Team
problemHeadline: Flaking paint, roller marks, and paint splatters on floors ruin home renovations
problemBody: Skipping wall primer on fresh plaster leads to peeling paint within 6 months.
bouulSolution: Professional painters apply 1 coat of alkali-resistant primer plus 2 coats of premium washable acrylic
Complete surface masking of door frames, light switches, and furniture with heavy drop cloths
Escrow released after final inspection under directional lighting for uniform coverage
partsNeeded: Heavyweight canvas drop cloths & masking tape
aiPromptExample: Quote interior paint: 'Repaint 120m² interior walls and ceilings in 3-bedroom home.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Surface Area: 320m² wall/ceiling total. Paint: Dulux Luxurious Silk. Escrow Quote: R14,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released upon inspecting uniform sheen and spotless clean floors.
pirbStandard: SAPMA (South African Paint Manufacturers Association) Standard & SANS 10043.

articleSections.heading: Alkali-Resistant Priming
articleSections.body: Fresh plaster is primed with alkali-resistant primer to prevent saponification and peeling.

articleSections.heading: Dust-Free Sanding
articleSections.body: Walls are sanded with vacuum-assisted sanders to ensure smooth paint adhesion without airborne dust.

title: Weatherproof Exterior House Painting & Coating
subtitle: UV and rain resistant exterior coatings with crack filling and high-pressure wash prep
author: Bouul Painting Team
problemHeadline: Harsh South African sun and winter rain cause exterior paint to chalk, crack, and fade
problemBody: Applying exterior paint over dirty, chalking walls results in immediate adhesion failure.
bouulSolution: High-pressure water jetting prep to remove dirt, mold, and chalked paint layer
Flexible acrylic crack filler applied to hairline plaster cracks before priming
2 coats of UV-resistant exterior pure acrylic paint with 7-to-10 year lifespan guarantee
partsNeeded: UV-resistant exterior acrylic paint (e.g. Wall & All)
aiPromptExample: Quote exterior paint: 'Full exterior repaint of 2-storey home including boundary walls.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Surface Area: 450m². Prep: Jet wash + crack seal. Finish: Plascon Wall & All. Escrow Quote: R26,000.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after full exterior inspection and clear cleanup.

articleSections.heading: High-Pressure Surface Prep
articleSections.body: 150-bar jet washing removes friable chalked paint, algae, and salt deposits prior to coating.

articleSections.heading: Flexible Crack Accommodation
articleSections.body: Hairline plaster cracks are V-cut and filled with elastomeric sealant that expands with thermal movement.

title: Roof Tile & IBR Sheet Weatherproof Painting
subtitle: Restoration and spray-coating for tile, corrugated iron, and Harvey tile roofs
author: Bouul Painting Team
problemHeadline: Faded, porous roof tiles absorb rainwater and cause ceiling damp leaks
problemBody: Painting a roof without fungicides allows lichen and moss to break down the new paint film.
bouulSolution: Fungicidal wash and high-pressure cleaning to remove deep-rooted lichen
Airless spray application of thick membrane roof acrylic for uniform film thickness
Escrow protection released after 48-hour dry weather inspection and leak test
aiPromptExample: Quote roof paint: 'High pressure clean and paint 200m² concrete tile roof in charcoal.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Roof Area: 200m². Prep: Fungicidal wash + 180-bar clean. Finish: 2x Coats Roof Acrylic. Escrow: R11,000.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after roof inspection and clean gutter check.
pirbStandard: SAPMA Roof Coating Standard & Fall Protection Safety Certified.

articleSections.heading: Fungicidal Lichen Decontamination
articleSections.body: Chemical bio-wash kills hidden moss spores inside tile pores before high-pressure cleaning.

articleSections.heading: Airless Spray Application
articleSections.body: Airless sprayers deliver an even, 150-micron wet film thickness across corrugated ridges.

title: Boundary Wall Damp Seal & Paint Restoration
subtitle: Damp-tolerant damp seal coating and painting for garden boundary walls
author: Bouul Painting Team
problemHeadline: Rising damp from garden beds turns boundary wall paint into peeling, bubbling blisters
problemBody: Standard acrylic paint applied over damp boundary walls fails within weeks.
bouulSolution: Application of silicone-based damp seal primer that penetrates porous masonry
Flexible fiber-reinforced coating over top plaster copings to shed rainwater
Escrow released after inspecting 100% blister-free finish
aiPromptExample: Quote boundary wall: 'Damp seal and repaint 80 meters of plaster boundary wall.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Length: 80m (160m² total sides). Prep: Scrape blistered paint + Damp Seal. Escrow: R8,500.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after wall inspection and clean garden beds.

articleSections.heading: Silicone Masonry Damp Sealing
articleSections.body: Damp seal primers react with free lime in masonry to form a hydrophobic water barrier.

articleSections.heading: Coping Rail Waterproofing
articleSections.body: Top edges of boundary walls receive fiber-membrane coating to prevent vertical water penetration.

title: Kitchen Cabinet & Furniture Spray Painting
subtitle: Factory-grade polyurethane spray refinishing for kitchen doors and furniture
author: Bouul Painting Team
problemHeadline: Replacing kitchen cabinets costs tens of thousands, while brush painting leaves ugly streaks
problemBody: Hand-brushing melamine or wood cabinets results in brush marks, drips, and sticky doors.
bouulSolution: Off-site or contained spray booth application of dual-component polyurethane lacquer
Complete surface de-greasing, high-adhesion primer, and satin/gloss topcoat
Escrow released after re-hanging cabinet doors with perfect alignment
partsNeeded: HVLP (High Volume Low Pressure) spray gun
aiPromptExample: Quote kitchen spray: 'Spray paint 18 kitchen cabinet doors from dark wood to satin white.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: 18 Doors + 6 Drawer fronts. Finish: 2K Polyurethane Satin White. Escrow Quote: R7,200.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after door re-installation and smooth finish inspection.

articleSections.heading: HVLP Spray Precision
articleSections.body: High Volume Low Pressure sprayers atomize paint into a fine mist for a factory-smooth glass finish.

articleSections.heading: 2K Polyurethane Toughness
articleSections.body: Two-pack polyurethane paint cures to an ultra-hard scratch and chemical resistant shell.

title: Wooden Deck, Door & Window Frame Varnishing
subtitle: Sanding and multi-coat marine varnish or oil treatment for exterior timber
author: Bouul Painting Team
problemHeadline: Sun-bleached wooden window frames shrink, leak water, and rot if left un-varnished
problemBody: Applying fresh varnish over cracked old varnish causes immediate peeling and dark patches.
bouulSolution: Complete sanding back to bare wood to remove UV-damaged gray fibers
3 coats of UV-absorbing penetrating wood preservative oil or marine varnish
Escrow released after inspecting smooth water-beading timber finish
aiPromptExample: Quote wood varnish: 'Sand back to bare wood and varnish 6 wooden window frames & front door.'
aiDiagnosisOutput: Scope: 6 Windows + 1 Front Door. Treatment: 3x Coats Woodoc 35 Marine Polyurethane. Escrow: R2,400.
escrowGuarantee: Escrow released after smooth dry finish and water-bead test.

articleSections.heading: Deep Sanding Recovery
articleSections.body: Grey UV-damaged surface wood is sanded down to fresh golden timber grain.

articleSections.heading: UV-Absorber Marine Oils
articleSections.body: Exterior oils contain micro-pigments and UV blockers that prevent wood fibers from bleaching.
